# lingtypology

[![Project Status: Active - The project has reached a stable, usable
state and is being actively
developed.](http://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](http://www.repostatus.org/#active)
[![R build
status](https://github.com/ropensci/lingtypology/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/lingtypology/actions)

[![CRAN
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/lingtypology)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lingtypology)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/lingtypology)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=lingtypology)
[![](https://badges.ropensci.org/95_status.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/onboarding/issues/95)
[![Research software
impact](http://depsy.org/api/package/cran/lingtypology/badge.svg)](http://depsy.org/package/r/lingtypology)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.815028.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.815028)

`lingtypology` package connects R with the [Glottolog database (v.
5.3)](https://glottolog.org/) and provides additional functionality for
linguistic mapping. The Glottolog database contains the catalogue of the
world’s languages. This package helps researchers to make linguistic
maps, using philosophy of [the Cross-Linguistic Linked Data
project](https://clld.org/), which uniform access to the data across
publications. This package is based on [`leaflet`
package](https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/), so `lingtypology` package
is a package for linguistic interactive mapping. You also might be
interested in looking into some alternatives to lingtypology:

- [lingtypology](https://pypi.org/project/lingtypology/) in Python by
  Michael Voronov;
- [glottospace](https://github.com/glottospace/glottospace) – R package
  for the geospatial analysis based on Glottolog by Sietze Norder et al;
- [`lingtypr`](https://gitlab.com/laurabecker/lingtypr) – R package
  which partially intersects with `lingtypology` functionality by Laura
  Becker;
- [`glottoTrees`](https://github.com/erichround/glottoTrees) – R package
  for visualising and modifing glottolog trees by Erich Round

## Installation

Get the stable version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("lingtypology")
```

… or get the development version from GitHub:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ropensci/lingtypology")
```

Sometimes installation failed because of the absence of the package
`crosstalk`. Just install it using command
`install.packages("crosstalk")`.

Load a library:

``` r

library(lingtypology)
```

For a detailed tutorial see [GitHub
pages](https://ropensci.github.io/lingtypology/).

You can contribute to `lingtypology`, but look through [contribution
info](https://github.com/ropensci/lingtypology/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
before.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Package index

## All functions

- [`abvd`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/abvd.md) :
  ABVD's Language identifiers
- [`abvd.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/abvd.feature.md)
  : Download ABVD data
- [`afbo.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/afbo.feature.md)
  : Download AfBo data
- [`aff.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/aff.lang.md)
  : Get affiliation by language
- [`area.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/area.lang.md)
  : Get macro area by language
- [`atlas.database()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/atlas.database.md)
  : Create an atlas
- [`autotyp`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/autotyp.md)
  : AUTOTYP's Language identifiers
- [`autotyp.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/autotyp.feature.md)
  : Download AUTOTYP data
- [`bantu`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/bantu.md) :
  BANTU's Language identifiers
- [`bantu.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/bantu.feature.md)
  : Download BANTU data
- [`bivaltyp.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/bivaltyp.feature.md)
  : Download BivalTyp data
- [`circassian`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/circassian.md)
  : Circassian villages in Russia
- [`countries`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/countries.md)
  : Catalogue of countries
- [`country.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/country.lang.md)
  : Get country by language
- [`eurasianphonology`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/eurasianphonology.md)
  : Eurasianphonology data
- [`eurasianphonology.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/eurasianphonology.feature.md)
  : Opens data from the database of Eurasian phonological inventories
- [`frequency_list.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/frequency_list.feature.md)
  : Download frequency list
- [`glottolog`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/glottolog.md)
  : Catalogue of languages of the world
- [`gltc.iso()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/gltc.iso.md)
  : Get Glottocode by ISO 639–3 code
- [`gltc.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/gltc.lang.md)
  : Get Glottocode by language
- [`grambank.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/grambank.feature.md)
  : Download Grambank data
- [`%>%`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/imports.md) :
  Objects imported from other packages
- [`is.glottolog()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/is.glottolog.md)
  : Are these languages in glottolog?
- [`iso.gltc()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/iso.gltc.md)
  : Get ISO 639–3 code by Glottocode
- [`iso.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/iso.lang.md)
  : Get ISO 639–3 code by language
- [`iso3.iso1()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/iso3.iso1.md)
  : Get ISO 639-3 code from ISO 639-1
- [`iso_639`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/iso_639.md)
  : ISO 639-3 is a set of codes that defines three-letter identifiers
  for all known human languages.
- [`lang.aff()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/lang.aff.md)
  : Get languages by affiliation
- [`lang.country()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/lang.country.md)
  : Get language by country
- [`lang.gltc()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/lang.gltc.md)
  : Get language by Glottocode
- [`lang.iso()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/lang.iso.md)
  : Get language by ISO 639–3 code
- [`lat.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/lat.lang.md)
  : Get latitude by language
- [`level.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/level.lang.md)
  : Get a level of language by language
- [`long.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/long.lang.md)
  : Get longitude by language
- [`map.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/map.feature.md)
  : Create a map
- [`oto_mangueanIC`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/oto_mangueanIC.md)
  : Oto-Manguean Inflectional Class Database Language identifiers
- [`oto_mangueanIC.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/oto_mangueanIC.feature.md)
  : Download Oto-Manguean Inflectional Class Database data
- [`phoible`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/phoible.md)
  : Phoible glottolog - language correspondencies
- [`phoible.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/phoible.feature.md)
  : Download PHOIBLE data
- [`phonological_profiles`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/phonological_profiles.md)
  : Number of consonants and presence of ejectives
- [`polygon.points_fd()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/polygon.points_fd.md)
  : Get polygons from fixed distance circles around coordinates
- [`polygon.points_kde()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/polygon.points_kde.md)
  : Get kernel density estimation poligon from coordinates
- [`providers`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/providers.md)
  : Providers
- [`sails.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/sails.feature.md)
  : Download SAILS data
- [`soundcomparisons`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/soundcomparisons.md)
  : SOUNDCOMPARISONS's Language identifiers
- [`soundcomparisons.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/soundcomparisons.feature.md)
  : Download SOUNDCOMPARISONS data
- [`subc.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/subc.lang.md)
  : Get subclassification by language
- [`uralex`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/uralex.md)
  : UraLex's Language identifiers
- [`uralex.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/uralex.feature.md)
  : Download UraLex data
- [`url.lang()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/url.lang.md)
  : Make a url-link to glottolog page for a language
- [`valpal.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/valpal.feature.md)
  : Download ValPaL data
- [`vanuatu.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/vanuatu.feature.md)
  : Download Vanuatu Voices data
- [`wals`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/wals.md) :
  WALS's Language identifiers
- [`wals.feature()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/lingtypology/reference/wals.feature.md)
  : Download WALS data
